phase_notes.note: EXT-02-0 landed: streamable-HTTP MCP calls work end to end (JSON and event-stream replies, 202 acknowledgements, 401/403 mapped with a bounded parsed challenge), static credentials by environment variable or literal header, egress gate and receipts, rapid mcp add --url, install writes type, stdio-only statements corrected.

EXT-03-1 and EXT-03-2 landed together: hook entries may be objects with an anchored matcher and a per-hook timeout, rejected (not skipped) when malformed, merged and deduplicated across both settings files and the managed policy, clamped by a managed max_timeout_ms; a timed-out hook's whole process group is ended.
